cases.situation: Coworker from marketing sent a 1-hour 'brainstorm' invite for tomorrow with no agenda. I'm on the data team and figure they want numbers from me. I'm slammed this week.
cases.reply: Hi Rosa, I'll skip the brainstorm tomorrow. If what you need from me is the signup numbers by channel for Q3, I can drop them in your doc by noon so they're there for the session. Does that cover it?
cases.note: Name what they likely need, decline the format, and give it another way with a time. No 'I'm swamped'.

cases.situation: 我是小团队的技术负责人，每周一上午有个一小时的全员周会，大部分内容跟我无关，我想退出，但老板是发起人。
cases.reply: 王总，想跟您商量一下：从下周开始我想不参加周一上午的全员周会了。技术这块的进展我每周五下班前会更新到共享周报里，您周一开会前就能看到。如果有议题需要我，提前说一声我就进来讲那一段。您看可以吗？
cases.note: 对上级退出例会：说清由什么替代你原来的贡献，留一个随叫随到的口子，最后请对方确认。

cases.situation: Some SaaS sales rep has emailed me 4 times this month asking for '15 minutes' to show me their HR tool. I'm the ops manager at a 40-person company. Want him to stop.
cases.reply: Hi Kyle, thanks for following up. We're not looking at HR tools this year, so please take me off the follow-up list. If that changes, I'll get in touch.
cases.note: A clear 'not now' ends the chase faster than silence. No reason to argue with.
